author: Praxis V
title: EtC+BRBG‑minimal v7b: Unit‑variance scaling on GRAPH only (kq=1280, λ_r=0.64, k=50, cosine)
abstract: Complementary ablation: apply sc.pp.scale(zero_center=False) before PCA on the graph path only; embedding path unchanged (PCA60→ComBat). Equal‑quota kNN uses k=50, kq=1280, cosine. Tests whether PCR collapse under full scaling arises from scaling the graph path.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np, scipy.sparse as sp
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from integration_utils import normalize_log1p_counts, select_features, pca_svd, ridge_residualize_per_pc, equal_quota_knn, set_neighbors_meta

def _scale_unitvar_csr(X):
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(X=X.copy())
    sc.pp.scale(ad_tmp, zero_center=False)
    Xs = ad_tmp.X
    return Xs.tocsr() if sp.issparse(Xs) else sp.csr_matrix(Xs)

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Common preprocessing + HVGs
    Xn = normalize_log1p_counts(adata)
    Xn = select_features(Xn, adata)

    # EMBEDDING path: NO scaling -> PCA60 -> ComBat
    Z_emb0 = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=60, random_state=0)
    ad_pca = ad.AnnData(X=Z_emb0.copy(), obs=adata.obs[['batch']].copy())
    sc.pp.combat(ad_pca, key='batch')
    X_emb = np.asarray(ad_pca.X, dtype=np.float32)

    # GRAPH path: scale -> PCA50 -> ridge residualize -> equal-quota kNN
    Xn_graph = _scale_unitvar_csr(Xn)
    Z_graph = pca_svd(Xn_graph, n_components=50, random_state=1)
    Zg_corr = ridge_residualize_per_pc(Z_graph, adata.obs['batch'].values, lam_r=0.64, l2=1e-3)
    C, D = equal_quota_knn(Zg_corr, batches=adata.obs['batch'].values, k=50, k_candidates=1280, metric='cosine')

    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = X_emb
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    set_neighbors_meta(adata, k=50, method='equal_quota+ridge_resid', metric='cosine', extra={'candidates': 1280, 'scaling': 'graph_only'})
    return adata
